items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps are unavailable; authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. TLS evidence only shows no certificates expiring within 30 days and does not establish complete TLS posture. Compliance is a technical baseline, not certification: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Risk severity is high for public launch and medium for bounded changes that add no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Exact decision: retain private launch gates, block security-sensitive releases, continue existing read-only evidence work, and permit only bounded reversible growth within existing compliance and disclosure boundaries. Do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, exploit targets, request duplicate telemetry, or conduct external outreach.

Continue the existing fleet security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated, redacted evidence or explicit unknowns for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness. Preserve private launch gates and do not mutate production.
